name: Unmake Fist
description: Strike with a fist that unmakes a thin layer of the foe's guard as it lands.

name: Remake Step
description: Unmake the ground ahead and make it again a pace on so the stride crosses the gap.

name: Restoring Hand
description: Unmake a bruise or a gash on an ally and make the flesh whole again.

name: Unmake Bind
description: Unmake the footing at a foe's feet and make clamps of stone in its place.

name: Unmake Edge
description: Make an edge that unmakes whatever it cuts so the wound does not close.

name: Unmake Ward
description: Make a ward that unmakes the force of a blow as it strikes and then makes itself anew.

name: Raze Lance
description: Make a lance and unmake everything in its path as it passes.

name: Rebuild Mantle
description: Wear a mantle that is unmade by each blow and made whole again so the user grows steadier.

name: Ruin Wave
description: Send a wave that unmakes cover and footing across the field and leaves bare ground.

name: Ruin Genesis
description: streams: Creation + Destruction; raze a stretch of the field to rubble and raise new ground in its place in one breath.

name: Blank Fist
description: Strike with a fist made from the emptiness of the air so it lands with no warning.

name: Blank Step
description: Make a footing from the emptiness ahead and stride across it.

name: Blank Gift
description: Make a calm clear space about an ally in which each breath and thought comes freely.

name: Blank Bind
description: Make bands from the emptiness and wind them round a foe's limbs.

name: Blank Cut
description: Make an edge from nothing and cut with it before the foe can see it.

name: Blank Screen
description: Make a ward from the emptiness before the body that lets a blow fall into nothing.

name: Blank Lance
description: Make a lance from emptiness and drive it through the guard with no sound.

name: Blank Mend
description: Make flesh from the emptiness over an ally's wound until nothing shows of the hurt.

name: Blank Rend
description: Make a void inside the foe's body so no armor or ward can turn the wound.

name: Nothing Made
description: streams: Creation + Void; make a thing from the emptiness itself and unmake the space it fills when it is done.
